diff --git a/debian/patches/lp2166842-avoid-spurious-disconnect-if-connecting-as-.patch b/debian/patches/lp2166842-avoid-spurious-disconnect-if-connecting-as-.patch
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..83e8236
--- /dev/null
+++ b/debian/patches/lp2166842-avoid-spurious-disconnect-if-connecting-as-.patch
@@ -0,0 +1,52 @@
+From 9ca942330f1829e0c0e2fd4d96ed5a06449af156 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
+From: "djm@openbsd.org" <djm@openbsd.org>
+Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 00:58:02 +0000
+Subject: [PATCH] upstream: avoid spurious disconnect if connecting as root
+ with
+
+`PermitRootLogin forced-commands-only` enabled and a authorized_keys entry
+_without_ a `command=` option before a key _with_ this option.
+
+Anthropic ANT-2026-29SEM083
+
+OpenBSD-Commit-ID: ea9c2afc636e120f68a0b70087afb1d5ecc1f9e0
+
+Bug-Ubuntu: https://bugs.launchpad.net/ubuntu/+source/openssh/+bug/2166842
+Origin: upstream, https://github.com/openssh/openssh-portable/commit/9ca942330f1829e0c0e2fd4d96ed5a06449af156
+---
+ auth-options.c | 12 +++++++++---
+ 1 file changed, 9 insertions(+), 3 deletions(-)
+
+diff --git a/auth-options.c b/auth-options.c
+index 4bbddd7ba..81fa4f68e 100644
+--- a/auth-options.c
++++ b/auth-options.c
+@@ -1,4 +1,4 @@
+-/* $OpenBSD: auth-options.c,v 1.103 2026/09/16 00:33:44 djm Exp $ */
++/* $OpenBSD: auth-options.c,v 1.104 2026/10/30 00:58:02 djm Exp $ */
+ /*
+  * Copyright (c) 2018 Damien Miller <djm@mindrot.org>
+  *
+@@ -821,11 +821,17 @@ sshauthopt_serialise(const struct sshauthopt *opts, struct sshbuf *m,
+ 	    0 : (u_int)opts->force_tun_device)) != 0)
+ 		return r;
+ 
+-	/* String options; these may be NULL */
++	/*
++	 * String options; these may be NULL. In untrusted mode the
++	 * contents of the forced command are hidden, but its presence
++	 * must be preserved as PermitRootLogin=forced-commands-only
++	 * depends on it.
++	 */
+ 	if ((r = serialise_nullable_string(m,
+ 	    untrusted ? "yes" : opts->cert_principals)) != 0 ||
+ 	    (r = serialise_nullable_string(m,
+-	    untrusted ? "true" : opts->force_command)) != 0 ||
++	    (untrusted && opts->force_command != NULL) ?
++	    "true" : opts->force_command)) != 0 ||
+ 	    (r = serialise_nullable_string(m,
+ 	    untrusted ? NULL : opts->required_from_host_cert)) != 0 ||
+ 	    (r = serialise_nullable_string(m,
+-- 
+2.53.0
+

 test-workaround-dd-broken-pipe.patch
